title: Malnutrition: Percentage and Association with Prognosis in Patients Hospitalized for Coronavirus Disease 2019.
abstract: Previous studies have found a correlation between malnutrition and prognosis in respiratory infections. Our objectives were to determine (i) the percentage of malnutrition, and (ii) its prognosis in patients admitted for coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19). In this monocentric retrospective study, we consecutively included all adult patients presenting with acute COVID-19 between 9 April and 29 May 2020. Malnutrition was diagnosed on low body mass index (BMI) and weight loss ≥ 5% in the previous month and/or ≥10% in the previous six months. The Nutritional Risk Index (NRI) defined nutritional risk.
